consequence.statement: Environments that relied on policy exceptions being enabled in all namespaces by the chart defaults find that the new default exception settings no longer enable exceptions in all namespaces, so their policy-exception setup may no longer behave as before.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading to Kyverno 1.13.0, review the chart's new default exception settings and explicitly configure them if policy exceptions must remain enabled beyond the new defaults (see CVE-2024-48921 for details).

assertion.statement: In Kyverno 1.13.0 the Helm chart's default exception settings change: the chart values of prior versions enabled policy exceptions by default for all namespaces, which created a potential security issue (CVE-2024-48921), and users who relied on policy exceptions being enabled in all namespaces are impacted.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The change text and evidence refer only to "the Helm chart values" default exception settings without naming the specific values keys, and no artifact context is provided to settle the values.yaml path.
